messages:
mira_fin: pinging billing team 87. Helios Biotech flagged a renewal discrepancy. invoice INV-2027-0520-333 shows a 20% enterprise discount applied to the Private Deployment Platform Fee. that discount should only apply to license lines per contract HEL-2025-045. can someone confirm?

mike_billing: pulling invoice and contract now. which amendment?

josh_sales: amendment AMD-HEL-2026-02 added an enterprise discount schedule (DISC-PREM-20) for years 2-3. sales notes indicate discount applies to 'license & support' not platform fee. i added that as plain text in CRM on 2026-12-15.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2027-0520-333 generated for HEL-2025-045  $76,000. PDF: https://invoices.internal/redwood/INV-2027-0520-333.pdf

mike_billing: looking at rate-plan mapping... the billing rule engine has a feature-flag experiment 'apply_enterprise_discount_to_platform' toggled on in staging and mistakenly promoted to prod on 2027-05-18 during a pricing rollout. it applied DISC-PREM-20 across license, support, AND platform fee.

leo_csm: customer called us; they noticed their renewal line "Platform Fee (after discount) $16,000" when it should have been $20,000. they are OK with the discount if documented, but sales said it wasn't supposed to cover platform fees.

eric_fpna: what's the net revenue delta? we need to know GL impact and approval path.

mike_billing: quick calc: annual platform fee $20,000 minus 20% = $4,000 under-recognized. support also got discounted incorrectly by $1,200. total unintended discount = $5,200. since this is a retrospective undercharge, we can either: 1) absorb and leave as is (customer-facing benefit) or 2) issue a catch-up invoice / debit memo for $5,200 and document reason.

mira_fin: customer expectation from sales was no platform discount. they accepted the upgrade because pricing was vetted on that basis. finance preference is to bill for the missed amount, but we should be careful with customer relationship.

josh_sales: agree we should bill but be gentle. propose we send a short note explaining this was a system error due to an internal pricing experiment and offer to split the catch-up across two invoices or give a one-time credit for late-payment friction if they push back.

sophie_finance: two quick checks: 1) approval threshold - $5,200 < $10k so finance auto-approve is fine. 2) revenue recognition - this is a past-period true-up; booking should go to current period as catch-up revenue and we should tag the memo. eric, please confirm GL treatment.

eric_fpna: confirm: post as catch-up revenue to current month with memo code "platform-discount-fix-hel". no revenue reversal needed because we underbilled (not over-recognized).

mike_billing: action plan: I'll disable the feature-flag immediately and backfill a fix to ensure future invoices respect discount scoping. I'll create DebitMemo-DM-2027-0521-412 for $5,200 (line: unintended discount reversal) and queue a customer-facing note. Draft ETA 1 business day.

billing-bot: Feature flag apply_enterprise_discount_to_platform toggled OFF in prod at 2027-05-20T16:22Z. Draft Debit Memo DM-2027-0521-412 created for HEL-2025-045  $5,200. PDF: https://invoices.internal/redwood/DM-2027-0521-412-draft.pdf

leo_csm: i'll pre-notify the customer with a friendly note and offer the split-pay option Josh suggested. will attach sales contract excerpt showing discount scope.

mira_fin: please ensure the debit memo includes explanation: "system misapplied enterprise discount to platform fee due to internal pricing experiment; charging remaining balance per contract HEL-2025-045."

mike_billing: will include and post once CS confirms acceptance. if customer declines, we'll evaluate absorbing part of the charge. posting will tag journal JNL-2027-05-CATCHUP.

sophie_finance: fine. please run a quick report for the last 30 days to ensure no other customers were affected by the flagged experiment and escalate any other cases here.

mike_billing: will run report and post results to this thread. thanks all.
